items.title: Collect a Blood pack
items.detail: Check first aid boxes and loot blood eagles in Summersville

items.title: Catch a Fish in the Ash Heap Region
items.detail: Fish at Lake Reynolds with a fishing rod

items.title: Collect a Burnt Book
items.detail: Burnt Books in burned buildings; house north of Summersville has 200+

items.title: Complete the Quest: Disturbed Grave
items.detail: Available only during The Slasher season; complete a public event to get the map

items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola Wild
items.detail: Obtain from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station and drink it

items.title: Kill a Honey Beast
items.detail: Kill at The Freak Show; target the head weakness

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Ash Heap Region
items.detail: Camden Park has dense Scorched population

items.title: Build Anything in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any small decoration or building piece at your C.A.M.P. or claimed workshop

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: Five to eight gnomes at The General's Steakhouse garden in the Cranberry Bog

items.title: Collect any flavor of Nuka-Cola
items.detail: Use Nuka-Cola Collectron Station or program any Collectron for Nuka-Cola

items.title: Complete a Head Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town bounty board; buy a wanted poster or earn via grunt hunts

items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola
items.detail: Collect from Nuka-Cola Collectron and drink it

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while in a Team
items.detail: Join any team first; Phantoms spawn at cabins and campgrounds

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume piece with 'Costume' in the description before killing

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Shovel during the "Disturbed Grave" Quest
items.detail: Activate Disturbed Grave quest; equip shovel and kill any enemy

items.title: Complete the Quest: Disturbed Grave
items.detail: Available only during The Slasher season; dig up the marked grave
